empty.noTeamDescription: The task board needs a team with at least one member before you can create and assign tasks.

composer.acceptanceTitle: Machine acceptance commands (S4): each command runs in order, all must exit 0 to pass; leave empty = no machine acceptance (falls back to human judgment)

card.awaitingApproval: Waiting for your approval to enter review
card.confirmMerge:
Merge branch "{{branch}}" back into the main branch and complete the task?
This will actually run git merge --no-ff — if there's a conflict, it will automatically revert (git merge --abort) and show an error.
card.confirmDelete: Delete task "{{title}}"? If a worktree has been created, it will be force-deleted too — this cannot be undone.
card.deleteHadUncommittedWarning: Task "{{title}}"'s worktree had uncommitted changes, which were force-cleared along with the delete — this cannot be undone.

advanceWarning: Task "{{title}}" did not pass acceptance, but was still moved to review (this slice is advisory-only and doesn't block the transition).
